office_does: The county coroner investigates sudden, unexpected, violent or suspicious deaths and determines their cause.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent George J Kelley (States No Party Preference), coroner since January 2023, is the only candidate. He submitted no voters'-guide statement.

candidates.summary: Grays Harbor County Coroner since January 2023 after about 36 years in law enforcement; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Elected in 2022 over Bob Kegel with 61% of the vote [S5]
About 36 years in law enforcement after serving as a Marine Corps military policeman [S2]
Moved the office to accreditation-ready space and added three staff in 2023 [S3]
